comp-mq9bq2vb4.html: We work with AI, computer vision, data and software - and we like using new technologies where they create real value. If you like solving complex technical problems and turning new technologies into practical solutions, you will find meaningful work here.

comp-mq9bq2vb4__item1.html: We work with AI, computer vision, data and software - and we like using new technologies where they create real value. If you like solving complex technical problems and turning new technologies into practical solutions, you will find meaningful work here.

comp-mq9bq2vb4__item-j9ples3e.html: In a smaller team, your work is visible. We value people who take responsibility, make decisions and care about the result - not only about finishing a task.

comp-mq9bq2vb4__item-j9plerjk.html: We know that great technology is built by great people. We want to work with skilled, curious colleagues who care about quality, keep improving and want their work to have impact.

comp-mq9bq2vb4__item-8054ad44-8cbf-4378-.html: We want to grow while keeping a friendly, supportive and collaborative culture. We keep communication open, practical and low on unnecessary hierarchy.

comp-mav5l9p84.html: We are looking for a technically strong and people-focused Team Leader to lead a small engineering team working on machine vision and industrial automation projects for leading international customers mainly in the tire and automotive industry.

comp-mav5l9p84__item-mrkpe6ni.html: We are looking for a technically strong and people-focused Team Leader to lead a small engineering team working on machine vision and industrial automation projects for leading international customers mainly in the tire and automotive industry.

comp-mav5l9p84__item-007ef91c-cfed-44aa-.html: As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead the delivery of industrial automation and machine vision projects from initial planning through successful customer handover.

comp-mav5l9p84__item-8da71ca8-7cdf-4c1d-.html: You will actively identify new business opportunities in the field of AI and vision technologies, lead consultative conversations with clients to understand their needs and propose suitable solutions, and present our product portfolio.

comp-mav5l9p84__item-a5f8ab36-2ad8-43b3-.html: As a Pre-Sales Engineer in our AI team, you'll support sales by understanding client needs, showcasing AI solutions, and helping design tailored technical proposals.

comp-mav5l9p84__item1.html: As a Vision Specialist, you'll design innovative solutions to optimize manufacturing and help drive the development of cutting-edge automation systems.
